arabic text: Ya Ali\nNawha kunaa hai zainab-e-muztar ali ke baad
english translation text: O Ali\nThe distressed Zainab laments after Ali

arabic text: Kohraam hai machaa huwa ghar ghar ali ke baad\nNawha kunaa hai zainab-e-muztar ali ke baad
english translation text: Turmoil has spread from house to house after Ali\nThe distressed Zainab laments after Ali

arabic text: Mehrab gam zadaa he namaazi kidhar gaya Viraan he rasool ka\nmimbar ali ke baad\nNawha kunaa hai zainab-e-muztar ali ke baad
english translation text: The prayer niche is grief-stricken—where has the worshipper gone? The Messenger's pulpit\nstands desolate after Ali\nThe distressed Zainab laments after Ali

arabic text: Manzar ubhar ke aagaya bazaar-e-shaam ka Zainab ke sar se jab giri\nchadar ali ke baad\nNawha kunaa hai zainab-e-muztar ali ke baad
english translation text: The marketplace of Shaam rose before her eyes when the chadar fell\nfrom Zainab's head after Ali\nThe distressed Zainab laments after Ali

arabic text: Shehzaadi ban ke ayi thi kufe me kal yahi Dar dar phiri hai zainab-e-\nmuztar ali ke baad\nNawha kunaa hai zainab-e-muztar ali ke baad
english translation text: Only yesterday she entered Kufa as a princess Yet the distressed Zainab\nwandered from door to door after Ali\nThe distressed Zainab laments after Ali

arabic text: Jo sar tha bosa gaa hai ali-o-muhammadi Neze se char gaya hai wohi\nsar ali ke baad\nNawha kunaa hai zainab-e-muztar ali ke baad
english translation text: The head kissed by Ali and Muhammad That same\nhead was raised upon a spear after Ali\nThe distressed Zainab laments after Ali

arabic text: Kuch khoon-e-murtaza ki hai kuch karbala ki hai Surki jo chaa gayi\nhai falak par ali ke baad\nNawha kunaa hai zainab-e-muztar ali ke baad
english translation text: Some of the redness is Murtaza's blood, and some is from Karbala The crimson that spread\nacross the heavens after Ali\nThe distressed Zainab laments after Ali

arabic text: Asghar ka nawne haal bi khoon me nahaagaya Ujra hai is tarha se\nbharaa ghar ali ke baad\nNawha kunaa hai zainab-e-muztar ali ke baad
english translation text: Even the infant Asghar was bathed in blood In this way, a flourishing\nhousehold was ruined after Ali\nThe distressed Zainab laments after Ali

arabic text: Dekho sitam zamaan ka zindaan shaam ka Rote rahe hai ale payambar\nali ke baad
english translation text: Behold the oppression of the age and the prison of Shaam The family of the Prophet\ncontinued to weep after Ali
